description.zh-CN: 桥接 MCP 生态：远端工具在加载时从 <数据根>/mcp.json 发现并冻结进工具清单（此处只列管理工具）
description.en-US: Bridges the MCP ecosystem: remote tools are discovered from <data root>/mcp.json at load time and frozen into the catalog (only management tools listed here)

tools.name: mcp_status
tools.description: List the configured MCP servers: connection state, tool count and the last connection error (if any), plus config-level errors. Pure.

tools.name: mcp_reload
tools.description: Re-read the MCP config and re-establish every server connection. The tool list was frozen when the plugin loaded — servers added to mcp.json afterwards only appear after reloading the plugin. Pure.
